title: A match answers its access decision as a case of the enum its call site writes
scope:
how a program compares `Core\Router\Match`'s access decision. What the compiler checks about
`allow:`, who dispatches and what the server enforces are [0102](0102.md)'s and [0199](0199.md)'s and
unchanged; `access()` stays as [0199](0199.md) § 1 shipped it.
